parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: The query content. Exact match is used.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.


> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return. Valid values: **1 to 100000**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **20**. Maximum value: **50**. Valid values: any integer from **1** to **50**.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description:
The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.
><notice>You must always specify SiteId. An error is reported if SiteId is not specified.</notice>

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The task execution status. Valid values:

- **Complete**: completed.
- **Refreshing**: refreshing.
- **Failed**: refresh failed.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The task type. Valid values:
- **file** (default): file refresh.
- **cachetag**: cache tag refresh.
- **directory**: directory refresh.
- **ignoreParams**: ignore parameters refresh.
- **hostname**: hostname refresh.
- **purgeall**: purge all cache under the site.
